actual.titulo: Married With Secrets • Obsession Has Its Price
actual.descripcion: Obsession Has Its Price | Bill Douglas is a respected doctor at Tufts University in Boston, but he becomes obsessed with a prostitute he met in a red light district known as the Combat Zone; together, they lead double lives ending in murder.

siguiente.titulo: Married With Secrets • Fear the Ether Man
siguiente.descripcion: Fear the Ether Man | A serial rapist known as the Ether Man lurks in the shadows of Albuquerque, N.M., and victims cannot identify the masked attacker; while the offender expands his hunting grounds, officials work to stop him before he attacks again.

lista.descripcion: The Mastermind | LAPD investigators are on the hunt for a criminal stealing expensive yachts, but what they find instead is a mild-mannered man among their own ranks.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Renovation Rage
lista.descripcion: Renovation Rage | A family moves one house over and closer to neighbors they've been friendly with for years; however, things go sour when they start renovations; the noise and waste ignite a vicious feud, ending in a frenzy of bullets and bloodshed.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Get Off My Property
lista.descripcion: Get Off My Property | When a large and boisterous family moves to a quiet street, the neighbors directly across from them get into immediate conflict over all the noise; soon the dispute consumes everyone and is only settled with the deadly crack of a baseball bat.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Bones of Contention
lista.descripcion: Bones of Contention | Two neighbors who are down on their luck bond over their struggle; when one buries the other in debt with a hustle gone wrong, things fall apart, but their co-dependence keeps them entwined until an act of revenge.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Better Get To Running
lista.descripcion: Better Get To Running | A couple moves to the country and ruins the quiet their new neighbors have enjoyed for years; parties, loud kids, and a junk-strewn lawn push the Vietnam vet next door to build a fence, but violence boils over when property lines are disputed.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Hillbilly Holler
lista.descripcion: Hillbilly Holler | A bachelor is welcomed into a neighborhood, but things go south when he starts disputing the property lines; the warring parties film each other extensively, but the cameras aren't running when violence erupts.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Cold Blood Country
lista.descripcion: Cold Blood Country | When a single man buys a home in a rural community, he becomes fast friends with his neighbor until a minor parking issue sets them at odds; police are soon summoned for everything from horse manure to death threats.

lista.titulo: Fatal Vows • Some Like It Dead
lista.descripcion: Some Like It Dead | Everyone is happy when Miranda marries Sam because she's pretty and he's cute and friendly, but Miranda's spending veers out of control and tears the couple apart until one of them looks outside the marriage and finds nothing short of murder.

lista.titulo: 48 Hours on ID
lista.descripcion: Estreno ║ "48 Hours" began as a documentary in 1986 and became a regular series two years later. It was built around a team of correspondents covering one subject for 48 consecutive hours. Over time it evolved into the premiere broadcast for law, crime and justice stores -- its journalists, for example, have been credited with uncovering new information that has led to high-profile cases being overturned and wrongfully convicted people released from prison. The large library of episodes are revisited in "48 Hours on ID," focusing on investigations that explore themes of jealousy, murder and deceit.

lista.titulo: Married to Evil • Too Good To Be True
lista.descripcion: Estreno ║ Too Good To Be True | Donna Andersen almost has it all: a nice house, a good job, and a loving family. But something's missing until James Montgomery enters her life. The future looks bright until Donna makes a discovery that turns her marriage into a living nightmare.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Boom Town
lista.descripcion: Boom Town | In a tight-knit community, a new family commits a slight against a community member causing all of their neighbors to turn against them and leading to an explosive conclusion.

lista.descripcion: Justice for Michelle | Alina Burroughs is eager to determine whether Michelle Witherell accidentally fell from her balcony, committed suicide, or was murdered; searching for the truth, she navigates a maze of conflicting pathology reports.

lista.titulo: Crime Scene Confidential • Cracking Brian's Case
lista.descripcion: Cracking Brian's Case | When family man Brian Hughes falls dead in his living room, it looks like a robbery gone wrong; the evidence soon suggests a plot hatched from inside his home, and CSI Alina Burroughs deciphers the ballistics to give a silenced victim the final word.

lista.titulo: The Night That Didn't End • Murdered in the Cold of Winter
lista.descripcion: Murdered in the Cold of Winter | In Stamping Ground, Ky., a young woman's dead body is found late at night by her brother and father; when detectives learn the victim was pregnant, they consider it a motive for murder and begin a homicide investigation.

lista.titulo: The Night That Didn't End • Stolen Memories
lista.descripcion: Stolen Memories | Sharon Ord and her family leave Scranton, Pa., to start a new life in Florida; then one of them disappears, turning their dream of a new life into a nightmare.

lista.titulo: The Night That Didn't End • A Sister's Loss
lista.descripcion: A Sister's Loss | In Ohio, a woman is found stabbed to death in her kitchen after she fails to show up for work; her sister is able to help detectives solve the case after a family heirloom is discovered during the investigation.

lista.titulo: Does Murder Sleep? • Kill Her in the Night
lista.descripcion: Kill Her in the Night | In June 2009, 61-year-old Wendy DiRodio's elderly mother discovers Wendy's body in the bedroom of their shared Ventura County, Calif., home; another murder weeks earlier leads investigators to wonder if a serial killer is on the loose.

lista.titulo: Does Murder Sleep? • To Kiss or Kill
lista.descripcion: To Kiss or Kill | When a home invasion leaves Bill Ross murdered in his sleep, detectives in Shelbyville, Tenn., scramble to uncover the identity of a pair of masked men; as they dig deeper, they discover a troubling web of secrets and lies.

lista.titulo: Does Murder Sleep? • Slept Through It All
lista.descripcion: Slept Through It All | A teenager sleeps through the murder of her father, Ken Eaton, at their home; as detectives probe into the beloved teacher's secret love life, they unravel a web of heartbreak, deceit and desire.
